small_sample.decision: Intervals overlap; raw rank does not establish A has higher population negativity.

unknown_bound.decision: Unknown exclusion changes estimand; report unknown fraction, do not show 40% as all-content negativity.

exposure.decision: Count doubled while within-sample rate halved. Neither is population risk without stable coverage.

did_confounding.decision: DiD arithmetic is correct yet causal claim false. Identical pretrends cannot rule out post-treatment confounding.

spend_proxy.decision: A seven-fold interval is a sensitivity scenario, not a calibrated confidence interval. Do not multiply post count by CPM.

creator_overlap.decision: Overlap changes the optimal creator set. If overlap unavailable, do not claim unique reach.

forecast_baseline.decision: Synthetic perfect weekly repetition favors seasonal naive; no evidence of real forecast gain or interval calibration.

identity.relationship: brand operated by group; store belongs to brand
identity.decision: Relationship edges are not identity equivalence. Never merge these three entities or allocate group expense without disclosure.

recovery_checks.scope: Research JSON roundtrip only; not product SavedWork or runtime recovery.
